note: Healing pilot for slim_batch's combined Qwen3.5-9B student, written 2026-10-29 before any healing run. The user approved a pilot of about 10M tokens for roughly $3-5 ('do it!'). One copy of the dense weights is both teacher and student; the student trains LoRA updates on every body projection plus its routers. KL is always from the stock dense model.

predictions.reproduce: Before training the student reproduces the combined model: KL within 0.05 of 1.491 and 64K bits per byte within 3% of 1.061.
predictions.kl: After the full run, domain-equal KL from the dense model on the original tokens is below 0.6 (unhealed 1.49).
predictions.bpb: After the full run, bits per byte with the 64K vocabulary are below 0.75 (unhealed 1.061; dense 0.624 with the full vocabulary, 0.656 with the 64K one).
predictions.early: At least 70% of the full run's KL reduction has happened by 3M tokens.
predictions.held_out: Biomed and argument, which are not in the healing mix, lose at least half as large a share of their KL as the in-mix domains do.
predictions.router: Router recall of the student's own best experts rises by at least 5 points from its value before training.
predictions.state: int16 state storage changes the healed student's KL by under 0.01.
predictions.cache: With the miss detector retrained on the healed student (16K rows of the 64K head), it falls back on under 40% of positions.
predictions.generate: The healed student answers at least 4 of the 16 GSM8K prompts correctly within 2,048 tokens (the dense model answered 9).

criteria.longer_run: Worth a longer healing run if KL is below 0.6 and still falling between the last two milestones by at least 10% of its value.
